metadata.description: Skills for development workflow, diagnosis, security, monitoring, deployment operations, drawing, Plane, and design stress testing. English-only. Installable via npm CLI and plugin marketplaces.

plugins.name: dev-orchestrator
plugins.description: Thin router for multi-role software delivery across research, product, engineering, backend, frontend, granular QA, security, monitoring, deployment, Plane, drawing, and roast.

plugins.name: feature-delivery
plugins.description: End-to-end feature delivery on a single trigger. Drives plan, implementation, focused tests, granular report-only QA, security review, and release handoff without manually invoking specialist skills. Stops only on hard gates.

plugins.name: delivery-from-task
plugins.description: Task-link delivery workflow for turning a Plane or Notion task link into a strict execution contract, then routing through product, engineering, implementation, QA, security, monitoring, or deployment skills.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Evidence-backed research for repo discovery, current external facts, technical feasibility, and decision briefs.

plugins.name: product-manager
plugins.description: Product management for PRDs, feature briefs, acceptance criteria, scope cuts, user flows, tradeoffs, and release slices.

plugins.name: engineering-manager
plugins.description: Engineering planning for architecture, implementation strategy, boundaries, interfaces, task sequencing, risk gates, and verification.

plugins.name: backend-developer
plugins.description: Backend implementation for server, API, data, queue, auth, idempotency, and migration work after an approved plan.

plugins.name: frontend-developer
plugins.description: Frontend implementation for UI, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, forms, state, API integration, accessibility, and responsive behavior.

plugins.name: diagnose
plugins.description: Disciplined diagnosis for hard bugs, failing tests, broken runtime behavior, flaky failures, unclear root causes, and performance regressions.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: QA routing for report-only quality assurance work across QA manager, QA engineer, and QA tester roles.

plugins.name: qa-manager
plugins.description: Report-only QA management for requirements analysis, PRD review, traceability, test strategy, test planning, test case design, defect reporting, and release sign-off.

plugins.name: qa-engineer
plugins.description: Report-only QA engineering for TDD, unit tests, integration tests, contract tests, BDD, E2E test code, mobile automation, framework selection, and CI test pipeline planning.

plugins.name: qa-tester
plugins.description: Report-only QA testing for browser UI checks, API testing, performance and load checks, visual regression, exploratory sessions, accessibility spot checks, and retest evidence.

plugins.name: security-sast
plugins.description: Whitebox/static security workflows for source code, JavaScript, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Fastify, config, dependencies, supply-chain risk, containers, IaC, threat modeling, scanner-output review, finding normalization, and hardening gates.

plugins.name: security-dast
plugins.description: Blackbox/dynamic security workflows for authorized runtime targets, JavaScript web apps, Next.js, Node.js, active surface scans, API and web probing, TLS checks, fuzzing, pentest reports, finding normalization, and hardening gates.

plugins.name: monitoring
plugins.description: Monitoring workflows for read-only health checks, dashboard and alert design, telemetry coverage, dependency and runtime vulnerability inventory, supply-chain risk signals, and incident triage.

plugins.name: deployment-ops
plugins.description: Deployment workflows for release readiness, GCP MIG rollouts, Docker service ops, Ansible Runner, Semaphore UI/API, rollback, and verification.

plugins.name: drawing
plugins.description: Diagram creation router for Mermaid and Excalidraw, covering Markdown-native diagrams and visual .excalidraw artifacts.

plugins.name: plane
plugins.description: Plane.so project management workflow for looking up, listing, creating, and updating work items through the Plane REST API.

plugins.name: roast
plugins.description: Relentless one-question-at-a-time design interview and docs-aware plan stress testing triggered by "roast me".
